svg.title: 源码依赖构建与运行拓扑
svg.desc: 历史草稿构建链：同仓的两个独立reactor经本地Maven仓库连接，按行业profile打包，再分别运行api、ops和worker；保留原目录与端口。

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
backend/（shop-parent reactor）
shop-base · shop-core · shop-merchant
shop-settle · shop-channel · shop-app
+ shop-industry-spi

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
backend-plugins/（独立 reactor，不进 shop-parent modules）
shop-industry-food · shop-industry-beauty
